info.name: RideLink - Account Service
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for account-service (signup, login/JWT, profile, password, role-based access).

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner - later requests use tokens and data saved by earlier ones. Each run generates fresh emails, so it can be re-run without cleaning the database.

baseUrl: http://localhost:8081 calls the service directly. Change it to http://localhost:8080/account-service to test through the API Gateway.

item.name: 06 - Role-Based Access
item.description: SecurityConfig rules: /api/v1/driver/** needs ROLE_DRIVER, /api/v1/passenger/** needs ROLE_PASSENGER. No endpoints exist under these paths yet, so an allowed request gets past security and then 404s.
